title: Rectangular QAM Modulator Baseband
text: 使用矩形正交幅度调制进行调制，输入 1 路、输出 1 路；按 {Output data type} 指定输出数据类型；{M-ary number} 指定调制阶数、{Input type} 指定输入类型 Integer、{Constellation ordering} 指定符号的映射顺序、{Constellation mapping} 指定用户定义的星座映射、{Normalization method} 指定星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between、{Minimum distance} 指定两个最近星座点之间的距离、{Average power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定平均功率、{Peak power, referenced to 1 ohm (watts)} 指定最大功率、{Phase offset (rad)} 指定信号星座的旋转、{View constellation} 绘制参考星座的选项，按实例取值。

ports.name: In
ports.summary: 输入数据 scalar | column vector

ports.name: Out
ports.summary: 输出数据 scalar | column vector

params.name: Constellation ordering
params.values: 符号的映射顺序 Gray (default) | Binary | User-defined

params.name: Constellation mapping
params.values: 用户定义的星座映射 [0:15] (default) | vector

params.name: Normalization method
params.values: 星座的缩放方法 Min. distance between symbols (default) | Average Power | Peak Power

params.name: Minimum distance
params.values: 两个最近星座点之间的距离 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Phase offset (rad)
params.values: 信号星座的旋转 0 (default) | numeric scalar

params.name: View constellation
params.values: 绘制参考星座的选项 button

params.name: Output data type
params.values: 输出数据类型 double (default) | single | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation |
